snippet.title: TORSO TENNIS  [Steam Demo Release Trailer]
snippet.description:
I just dropped the demo for TORSO TENNIS! Download for free on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2824780/TORSO_TENNIS/


It's a tennis roguelike! Draft limbs, graft them to your torso, then jump into multi-ball tennis matches. Upgrade your limbs, get wild permaboost tattoos, and perfect your build synergies to ace the season in this thrilling run-based roguesports game.

#gamedev #indiegame #roguelike
